<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow Blob Character — Animated</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#f2f2ef;}
  canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

/* ---------- deterministic RNG ---------- */
function mulberry32(a){return function(){a|=0;a=a+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(a^a>>>15,1|a);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296;};}
const rng = mulberry32(20240613);

/* ---------- renderer / scene / camera ---------- */
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer:true, antialias:true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NoToneMapping;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf3f3f0);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 240/294, 0.1, 60);
camera.position.set(0, 1.55, 6.0);
camera.lookAt(0, 1.55, 0);
scene.add(camera);

/* ---------- background: soft gradient + fine dither noise ---------- */
function makeGradientTex(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=64; c.height=64;
  const g=c.getContext('2d');
  const rad=g.createRadialGradient(32,30,6,32,32,46);
  rad.addColorStop(0,'#f8f8f6');
  rad.addColorStop(0.65,'#f2f2ef');
  rad.addColorStop(1,'#e6e6e2');
  g.fillStyle=rad; g.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace; return t;
}
function makeNoiseTex(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=64; c.height=64;
  const g=c.getContext('2d');
  const img=g.createImageData(64,64);
  for(let i=0;i<64*64;i++){
    const v=rng();
    const dark=v<0.5;
    img.data[i*4+0]=dark?40:255;
    img.data[i*4+1]=dark?40:255;
    img.data[i*4+2]=dark?38:255;
    img.data[i*4+3]=Math.floor(rng()*22);
  }
  g.putImageData(img,0,0);
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.wrapS=t.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping; t.repeat.set(3.75,4.6);
  t.magFilter=THREE.NearestFilter; t.minFilter=THREE.NearestFilter;
  t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace; return t;
}
const bgDist=8, bgH=2*bgDist*Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(15)), bgW=bgH*(240/294);
const bgGrad=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(bgW*1.05,bgH*1.05),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:makeGradientTex(),depthWrite:false}));
bgGrad.position.set(0,0,-bgDist); bgGrad.renderOrder=-2; bgGrad.name='background-gradient';
camera.add(bgGrad);
const bgNoise=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(bgW*1.05,bgH*1.05),
  new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:makeNoiseTex(),transparent:true,depthWrite:false}));
bgNoise.position.set(0,0,-bgDist+0.01); bgNoise.renderOrder=-1; bgNoise.name='background-noise';
camera.add(bgNoise);

/* ---------- lights (read from every side) ---------- */
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xcfc0a4, 0.95));
const key=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3dc, 1.55); key.position.set(-2.5,4.5,3.5); scene.add(key);
const fill=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe8eeff, 0.55); fill.position.set(3,1.2,2.5); scene.add(fill);
const rim=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5); rim.position.set(0.5,3,-4); scene.add(rim);
const back=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff0d8, 0.35); back.position.set(-2,1,-3); scene.add(back);

/* ---------- materials ---------- */
const COL_BODY=0xf0cd5e, COL_BELLY='#f8eeda', COL_DARK=0x4c463f, COL_FACE=0x5a4a3a;
const matBody=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:COL_BODY,roughness:0.82,metalness:0});
const matDark=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:COL_DARK,roughness:0.9,metalness:0});
const matFace=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:COL_FACE,roughness:0.9,metalness:0});
const matWhite=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xf6f4ec,roughness:0.55,metalness:0});
const matIris=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x3f9e63,roughness:0.5,metalness:0});
const matPupil=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x20241f,roughness:0.6,metalness:0});

function makeBodyTex(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=64; c.height=64;
  const g=c.getContext('2d');
  g.fillStyle='#f0cd5e'; g.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  const vg=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,64);
  vg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,244,200,0.25)');
  vg.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
  vg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(190,140,40,0.18)');
  g.fillStyle=vg; g.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  function belly(cx){
    g.save(); g.translate(cx,37.5); g.scale(10.5,15.5);
    const rg=g.createRadialGradient(0,-0.1,0.1,0,0,1);
    rg.addColorStop(0,COL_BELLY);
    rg.addColorStop(0.72,COL_BELLY);
    rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(248,238,218,0)');
    g.fillStyle=rg; g.beginPath(); g.arc(0,0,1,0,Math.PI*2); g.fill(); g.restore();
  }
  belly(0); belly(64);
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  t.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace; t.wrapS=THREE.RepeatWrapping;
  return t;
}
matBody.map=makeBodyTex(); matBody.color.set(0xffffff);

/* ---------- character ---------- */
const character=new THREE.Group(); character.name='character-blob'; scene.add(character);

const profileCtrl=[
  [0.001,0.42],[0.30,0.50],[0.52,0.62],[0.65,0.80],[0.715,1.05],[0.72,1.25],
  [0.69,1.50],[0.62,1.75],[0.52,1.98],[0.43,2.18],[0.36,2.38],[0.325,2.58],
  [0.30,2.75],[0.24,2.88],[0.13,2.97],[0.001,3.02]
].map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(p[0],p[1],0));
const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(profileCtrl);
const pts=[];
for(let i=0;i<=96;i++){
  const p=curve.getPoint(i/96);
  pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0.001,p.x),p.y));
}
const body=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts,72),matBody); body.name='torso';
character.add(body);

/* head group (face features) */
const head=new THREE.Group(); head.name='head'; head.position.set(0,2.68,0);
character.add(head);
const eyes=new THREE.Group(); eyes.name='eyes'; head.add(eyes);

function closedEye(x){
  const arc=2.1;
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.052,0.0095,8,20,arc),matFace);
  m.rotation.z=(Math.PI-arc)/2;
  m.position.set(x,0.055,0.283);
  m.rotation.y=x>0?0.32:-0.32;
  return m;
}
function openEye(x){
  const g=new THREE.Group(); g.name=x<0?'eye-open-left':'eye-open-right';
  g.position.set(x,0.055,0.278); g.rotation.y=x>0?0.32:-0.32;
  const sclera=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.055,16,12),matWhite);
  sclera.scale.set(1,1,0.55); sclera.name='sclera';
  const iris=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.032,14,10),matIris);
  iris.scale.set(1,1,0.4); iris.position.z=0.036; iris.name='iris';
  const pupil=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.015,10,8),matPupil);
  pupil.scale.set(1,1,0.4); pupil.position.z=0.048; pupil.name='pupil';
  g.add(sclera,iris,pupil);
  return g;
}
const eyeCL=closedEye(-0.105); eyeCL.name='eye-closed-left';
const eyeCR=closedEye(0.105);  eyeCR.name='eye-closed-right';
const eyeOL=openEye(-0.105), eyeOR=openEye(0.105);
eyes.add(eyeCL,eyeCR,eyeOL,eyeOR);

const mouth=new THREE.Group(); mouth.name='mouth'; head.add(mouth);
const smileArc=1.5;
const smileMesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.038,0.008,8,18,smileArc),matFace);
smileMesh.rotation.z=Math.PI+(Math.PI-smileArc)/2;
smileMesh.position.set(0,-0.075,0.298); smileMesh.name='mouth-smile';
const flatMesh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.0075,0.075,4,8),matFace);
flatMesh.rotation.z=Math.PI/2;
flatMesh.position.set(0,-0.075,0.298); flatMesh.name='mouth-flat';
mouth.add(smileMesh,flatMesh);

/* arms with elbow joints */
const fingerRefs=[];
function makeArm(side){
  const shoulder=new THREE.Group();
  shoulder.name=side<0?'arm-left':'arm-right';
  shoulder.position.set(side*0.40,2.05,0.02);
  const Lu=0.55, Lf=0.50;
  const cap=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.082,14,12),matBody);
  const upper=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.078,0.062,Lu,14),matBody);
  upper.position.y=-Lu/2; upper.name='upper-arm';
  shoulder.add(cap,upper);
  const elbow=new THREE.Group(); elbow.name=side<0?'elbow-left':'elbow-right';
  elbow.position.set(0,-Lu,0);
  const fore=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.060,0.050,Lf,14),matBody);
  fore.position.y=-Lf/2; fore.name='forearm';
  elbow.add(fore);
  const hand=new THREE.Group(); hand.name=side<0?'hand-left':'hand-right';
  hand.position.set(0,-Lf,0);
  const palm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.088,16,14),matDark);
  palm.scale.set(0.92,1.12,0.55); palm.position.y=-0.05; palm.name='palm';
  hand.add(palm);
  const fingers=new THREE.Group(); fingers.name='fingers'; hand.add(fingers);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const fx=-0.052+i*0.0345;
    const f=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.0205,0.085,4,8),matDark);
    f.position.set(fx,-0.155,0.005);
    f.rotation.x=0.12;
    f.userData.base=(i-1.5);
    fingers.add(f); fingerRefs.push(f);
  }
  const thumb=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.021,0.06,4,8),matDark);
  thumb.position.set(-side*0.075,-0.07,0.02);
  thumb.rotation.z=-side*0.75;
  fingers.add(thumb);
  elbow.add(hand);
  shoulder.add(elbow);
  shoulder.userData.elbow=elbow;
  return shoulder;
}
const armL=makeArm(-1), armR=makeArm(1);
character.add(armL,armR);

/* legs + feet */
function makeLeg(side){
  const leg=new THREE.Group(); leg.name=side<0?'leg-left':'leg-right';
  const x=side<0?-0.27:0.23;
  leg.position.set(x,0.78,0);
  const thigh=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.195,0.135,0.72,18),matBody);
  thigh.position.y=-0.36; thigh.name='leg-mesh';
  leg.add(thigh);
  const foot=new THREE.Group(); foot.name=side<0?'foot-left':'foot-right';
  foot.position.set(0,-0.71,0.05);
  const fm=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15,16,12),matBody);
  fm.scale.set(1,0.45,1.5);
  foot.add(fm);
  leg.add(foot);
  return leg;
}
character.add(makeLeg(-1),makeLeg(1));

/* ---------- keyframe poses (times in ms, loop 5540) ---------- */
const P0={ry:0,z:0,lean:0,hx:0.02,hz:0,open:0,wide:1,smile:1,spread:0,
  sLx:0.04,sLz:-0.44,eLx:-0.12,eLz:0, sRx:0.04,sRz:0.16,eRx:-0.12,eRz:0};
const KEYS=[
  {t:0,    p:P0},
  /* giggle: both hands cupped at mouth, eyes open, head ducked */
  {t:800,  p:{ry:0,z:0.05,lean:0.03,hx:0.14,hz:0.07,open:1,wide:1,smile:0.7,spread:0.2,
    sLx:-1.30,sLz:0.62,eLx:-1.95,eLz:0, sRx:-1.30,sRz:-0.62,eRx:-1.95,eRz:0}},
  /* wave hello: left hand up, right arm out */
  {t:1530, p:{ry:0,z:0,lean:0,hx:0.02,hz:-0.06,open:1,wide:1,smile:1,spread:1,
    sLx:-0.20,sLz:-1.25,eLx:-0.25,eLz:-1.35, sRx:0.15,sRz:0.85,eRx:-0.35,eRz:0.15}},
  /* lean in close to camera, wide eyes, flat mouth */
  {t:2330, p:{ry:0,z:1.55,lean:0.07,hx:-0.06,hz:0,open:1,wide:1.28,smile:0,spread:0.4,
    sLx:0.10,sLz:-0.80,eLx:-0.15,eLz:0, sRx:0.10,sRz:0.80,eRx:-0.15,eRz:0}},
  /* back off, hand gesturing at chest, big smile */
  {t:3130, p:{ry:0,z:0.1,lean:0,hx:0.03,hz:0.05,open:1,wide:1,smile:1.25,spread:1,
    sLx:-0.85,sLz:-0.15,eLx:-1.15,eLz:-0.20, sRx:0.22,sRz:0.55,eRx:-0.35,eRz:0}},
  /* turn to face left: far arm bent up, near arm reaching forward */
  {t:3930, p:{ry:-Math.PI/2,z:0,lean:0,hx:0,hz:0,open:1,wide:1,smile:0.8,spread:0.3,
    sLx:-1.50,sLz:0.0,eLx:-1.60,eLz:0, sRx:-1.50,sRz:-0.08,eRx:-0.05,eRz:0}},
  /* both arms reaching forward */
  {t:4670, p:{ry:-Math.PI/2,z:0,lean:0.02,hx:0.05,hz:0,open:1,wide:1,smile:0.6,spread:0.6,
    sLx:-1.62,sLz:0.10,eLx:-0.06,eLz:0, sRx:-1.38,sRz:-0.12,eRx:-0.12,eRz:0}},
  /* arms drop to sides, still in profile */
  {t:5470, p:{ry:-Math.PI/2,z:0,lean:0,hx:0.02,hz:0,open:1,wide:1,smile:0.5,spread:0,
    sLx:0.28,sLz:-0.15,eLx:-0.18,eLz:0, sRx:0.28,sRz:0.15,eRx:-0.18,eRz:0}},
  /* loop cut back to start */
  {t:5540, p:P0}
];
const FIELDS=Object.keys(P0);
const smooth=u=>u*u*(3-2*u);
function poseAt(t){
  t=((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
  let i=0;
  while(i<KEYS.length-2 && t>=KEYS[i+1].t) i++;
  const a=KEYS[i], b=KEYS[i+1];
  const u=smooth(Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(t-a.t)/(b.t-a.t))));
  const out={};
  for(const f of FIELDS) out[f]=a.p[f]+(b.p[f]-a.p[f])*u;
  return out;
}

/* ---------- API ---------- */
function render(t){
  const p=poseAt(t);
  const ph=(t%5540)/5540*Math.PI*2;
  character.rotation.set(p.lean, p.ry+0.015*Math.sin(ph), 0);
  character.position.set(0, 0.018*Math.sin(2*ph), p.z);
  head.rotation.set(p.hx,0,p.hz);

  /* eyes: closed arcs <-> open green eyes */
  const o=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,p.open));
  const cs=Math.max(0.001,1-o), os=Math.max(0.001,o);
  eyeCL.visible=eyeCR.visible=o<0.98;
  eyeOL.visible=eyeOR.visible=o>0.02;
  eyeCL.scale.setScalar(cs); eyeCR.scale.setScalar(cs);
  eyeOL.scale.set(p.wide, p.wide*os, p.wide);
  eyeOR.scale.set(p.wide, p.wide*os, p.wide);

  /* mouth: smile <-> flat */
  const s=Math.min(1.4,Math.max(0,p.smile));
  smileMesh.visible=s>0.03; flatMesh.visible=s<0.97;
  smileMesh.scale.setScalar(Math.max(0.001,s));
  flatMesh.scale.setScalar(Math.max(0.001,1-Math.min(1,s)));

  /* arms */
  armL.rotation.set(p.sLx,0,p.sLz);
  armR.rotation.set(p.sRx,0,p.sRz);
  armL.userData.elbow.rotation.set(p.eLx,0,p.eLz);
  armR.userData.elbow.rotation.set(p.eRx,0,p.eRz);
  for(const f of fingerRefs) f.rotation.z=f.userData.base*(0.10+0.22*p.spread);

  renderer.render(scene,camera);
}
window.nwb={ scene, renderer, cameras:{ ref:camera }, characters:[character], render, ready:true };
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
